remediation.sourcePartitioningBefore: none before the model call: the whole unit (38,529 chars) in one message; segmentation only after the call, inside source coverage
remediation.sourcePartitioningAfter: deterministic SOURCE SLOTS before any call (slots.ts): each structural node's own text (text minus children) split at independent segment bounds (sentence/line terminators - the same bounds source coverage credits against); content-free stretches merged into their successor; slots tile the region exactly; each slot carries its enclosing nodes' lead-ins as read-only context. Fallback without a structural index: independent segments. Chewy 6.08: 335 slots (method STRUCTURAL_NODES), batched into 7 bounded calls of <= 6,000 primary chars (prompts 17.7k-24.8k chars each, system prompt included).
remediation.itemIdMechanismBefore: hash(candidateRef, role, regionId, charStart, charEnd, valueSignature, v3) - the model's own excerpt boundaries were the identity
remediation.itemIdMechanismAfter: hash(candidateRef, role, regionId, slotId, coordinationSubIndex, clusterOrdinal, valueSignature, v4) - slot = deterministic structural anchor of the verified span's start; coordination sub-index = count of and/or/;/enumerator-comma boundaries before the start within the slot; cluster ordinal = source-order rank among same-key items that do not overlap; never the excerpt boundary, the proposition wording or model-listed identifiers (measured: identifiers halve cross-run agreement)
remediation.granularityMechanismBefore: the model's own judgment of 'atomic proposition' over the whole unit; exact-id collisions were the only duplicate rule (12% intra-run near-duplicates survived)
remediation.granularityMechanismAfter: canonical: one item per (slot, coordination sub-index, role, values) source position; same-key items merge when they are the same proposition - overlapping by >= 50% of the longer span (value-free) or of the shorter span (valued: a source-owned number pins the proposition); disjoint or nested-without-value items stay distinct with a deterministic ordinal. Merge = span union, values/identifiers union, strongest materiality, first wording kept, count recorded (mergedDuplicates). First-pass and gap items are normalized together so clustering is global.
remediation.gapPassBefore: one call over run-specific unaccounted FRAGMENTS (128/133 per run) - half of every run's items came from run-dependent boundaries
remediation.gapPassAfter: bounded calls over the SLOTS that still contain unaccounted text, each slot re-presented in full with its unaccounted stretches quoted; deterministic boundaries; items can only be added; whole-slot deterministic identity applies
remediation.promptChanges: v4: obligation 12 (slots define the boundaries; slotId on every item; context is read-only) and slot-structured user content; roles, materiality, ambiguity, security and the synthetic example are unchanged - no consistency exhortation, no template
remediation.wireChanges: optional slotId on the item (tolerant; a wrong or missing slotId is recovered from the located excerpt)
remediation.callShape: first pass: one call per operative-region slot batch (cross-reference expansion regions stay read-only context, as v3); gap: one call per affected-slot batch; system prompt re-sent per call
remediation.trustSafety: unchanged: anti-hallucination gate, deterministic value completion, whole-unit source coverage, INVENTORY_COVERAGE_GAP / EMPTY_SUSPECT / FAILED semantics, freeze hash. Slots never suppress text; a batch failure is INVENTORY_FAILED for the unit.
